name: agents latest verification
command:
set -o pipefail
docker compose run --rm --no-deps agents-marazul sh -c 'python -m py_compile app/*.py agents/*.py orchestration/*.py schemas/*.py tools/*.py tests/*.py && python tests/test_booking_flow.py && python tests/test_http_auth.py'
description: Run the executable Python agent checks and compile every agent module from the live mounted source.
